purpose: Prevents the agent capability surface from silently drifting out of the canonical operation registry. The generator used to fall back to operation_id=null with no signal, so an entire HTTP surface could ship outside the canonical contract unnoticed.
why_a_ratchet: A strict set-parity gate cannot be adopted today: most descriptors are not yet bound. This records the measured baseline and forbids regression, so coverage can only improve.
notes: min_bound_descriptors may only increase; max_unbound_http_descriptors may only decrease.
Raising the floor without lowering the ceiling is a regression and fails closed.
These are floors, not targets. They are removed entirely once full set correspondence is reached.

The ceiling counts distinct method+path pairs across every operation of every capability, so a multi-route tool contributes each of its routes. An earlier count of 107 was taken from one operation_policy per descriptor and undercounted multi-route capabilities.
